**Finding: compliant — no audit rights run against IBM.**

- Every audit/inspection/verification mechanic in the Agreement binds MSL and benefits us: Base § 7.0 process audits (p0163–p0164), consigned-inventory audit (p0909), acceptance/source inspection (p1047), IBM-owned tooling inspection (p1107, p1113), IBM's retained audit right over system/software access (p1136), Attachment 6 § 4.0 additional audit rights (p1310–p1314), Appendix A § 4 audits of MSL's books, records and facilities (p1443–p1448), and MSL's access obligation for IBM inspection teams (p1551).
- § 16.14 Records is a mutual five-year retention covenant only — it grants MSL no audit, inspection or access right against IBM, so it does not engage the rule.
- The one detailed audit regime (Appendix A § 4) is itself constrained in our favour (45 days' written notice, business hours, independent CPA, auditing party bears cost absent a material discrepancy, no more than semiannual frequency).
- No redline proposed; there is no Customer-side audit exposure on frequency, notice, cost allocation, or system access.
